title: System Settings
reset_app_desc: Resetting the app will clear all settings, model configurations, and agent data. This action is irreversible.
reset_app_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset the app? This will permanently delete all data and the app will restart.
clear_remembered_choices_desc: Clear all automatic confirmation records you've previously checked 'Remember my choice'.
clear_remembered_choices_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear all remembered choices? You will be prompted again for future operations.
channels_desc: Connect your AI agent to external chat platforms for 24/7 automated replies.
channels_agent_desc: Control the activation status of external channels associated with this agent
channels_bot_independent_notice: Each bot is independent. Add/Delete is synced automatically; config changes require manual save.
bind_agent_desc: Specify which agent should respond to conversations on this channel
lark_desc: Coming soon: support for connecting via Lark custom apps...
global_proxy_desc: Set a global proxy address. Bots with 'Use Global Proxy' enabled will connect via this address.
telegram_use_global_proxy_desc: When enabled, Telegram will connect using the proxy address configured in 'General Settings'.
